objective: Finish the frontend tidy-ups with no change in behaviour or look: one ScrollTable in components/ui, one fetchTeams and one teams query key in api/stats.ts, the shared formatter at src/lib/format.ts, the caller-less GameScore deleted, a scrim token for Dialog's backdrop, and the stale LikeButton, Button and openapi-fetch comments corrected.
acceptance_criteria: Start gate: the unit starts only when no other PR that changes frontend/ is open, Renovate's included. The PR body records the gh pr list result at the start and again before handing over.

Test-first: commit the failing tests alone before the implementation. frontend/src/test/frontend-tidy-end-state.test.ts pins every end state below by reading files from disk, fails today on each one, and passes after the implementation. Comments are stripped only where a criterion is about code rather than a comment.

ScrollTable: frontend/src/components/ui/ScrollTable.tsx is the only file under src that defines ScrollTable or ColumnHeader. frontend/src/components/stats-nav/ScrollTable.tsx and frontend/src/features/players/ScrollTable.tsx are gone. Every table in stats-nav, features/stats, features/players and features/compose/StatsPicker uses it, and neither StatsNav.module.css nor Players.module.css keeps its own .scroll, .table or caption rules.

fetchTeams: frontend/src/api/stats.ts is the only file under src that defines fetchTeams or calls GET /events/teams, and TEAMS_KEY is the only constant or literal spelling the key. The definitions in features/profile/api.ts and auth/ProfileSetupPage.tsx, TEAMS_QUERY_KEY and ProfileSetupPage's inline key are gone. A failed read still throws 'GET /events/teams answered <status>', and a page that loaded the teams once does not fetch them again in another view while the cached entry is fresh.

Formatter: frontend/src/lib/format.ts exists with the same exports as today's features/games/format.ts, whose file is gone. format.test.ts and format-player.test.ts move beside it with their assertions unchanged. Nothing under src imports a path ending games/format. features/feed/previews/format.ts is a different module and stays where it is.

Isolation tests are kept, not loosened: games-isolation.test.ts, stats-isolation.test.ts and stats-nav-lazy.test.ts drop the exception for features/games/format, so no feature imports another feature's module for formatting and nothing under components/ imports features/ at all.

GameScore: GameScore.tsx, GameScore.module.css and GameScore.test.tsx are gone, and games-css.test.ts, feed-css.test.ts and search-isolation.test.ts no longer name them. No source under src names GameScore. ChevronDownIcon stays: Dialog uses it.

Scrim: frontend/src/styles/tokens.css defines --color-scrim once, in the light :root only, and tokens.test.ts pins it. Dialog.module.css's ::backdrop uses var(--color-scrim) and does not name --neutral-950. The composited colour over any page, in both themes, is the same as today's #011d28 at 0.6.

Comments: no file under src names LikeButton. Button.tsx's comment no longer says that no Button carries aria-pressed. auth/profile.ts's comment no longer says a body-less non-2xx is error: "", and says instead that it can come back with a falsy error, an empty string or undefined depending on the openapi-fetch version and the response's headers, which is why the status is what is branched on. The code in fetchProfile does not change.

Behaviour is proven unchanged three ways, each reported in the PR. (1) Tests: the only edits to existing tests are import paths, moved files, the removed GameScore rows, the tightened isolation exceptions, the budgets, tokens.test.ts and comments; the PR lists each edited test with its reason, and no behavioural assertion is removed or weakened. (2) Gates: npm test, typecheck, lint, build and the frontend container pass. (3) Browser: the before/after comparison in the next criterion.

Before/after browser comparison, origin/main's build against this branch's, at 360 and 1280 wide, light and dark, per wiki/CodeContext/FrontendUI/verification.md, each row reported as really checked or NOT DONE. Compare computed styles and bounding rects, equal within 0.5 px, for the region, table, caption, thead th, tbody row, td, .name and .figure cells, and the post-about cell. Row 1: a player page's career, season and game-log tables. Row 2: Stats standings and a record table. Row 3: Records > Seasonal leaders. Row 4: the compose picker's box score. Row 5: keyboard focus on a table region, same ring and offset on all of the above. Row 6: the Dialog open over the feed, the pixels of the dimmed page equal within 1 per channel. Row 7: at 360 wide each table scrolls inside its region and the page's scrollWidth equals its clientWidth. API responses may come from page.route, labelled synthetic in the PR.

frontend/src/test/bundle-budgets/FRONTEND-028.ts declares, in the test commit, every output the unit changes, adds or removes. The entry JS chunk does not grow past tolerance (entryJsGzipGrowth is 0) and the entry CSS grows by at most 64 bytes gzip. features/profile and auth/ProfileSetupPage reach api/stats lazily, so it does not move into the entry.
No new dependency, no new behaviour, no new visual state, no FrontendUI or Standards edit. The PR body lists the later Director PR's rows from the brief.
wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x08-frontend.md records the new paths for ScrollTable, fetchTeams and the formatter, that GameScore is gone, and removes the formatter's feature-boundary exception.
